items.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 6 and 8. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
items.explanation: По теореме Пифагора: √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10.

items.stem: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 13 and one leg of length 5. What is the length of the other leg?
items.explanation: √(169 − 25) = √144 = 12 (B). 8 — вычли длины, а не квадраты; 14 и 18 — сложили квадраты или длины.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle. The side opposite angle A has length 3, and the hypotenuse has length 5. What is sin A?
items.explanation: sin = противолежащий / гипотенуза = 3/5 (A). 4/5 — cos A; 3/4 — tan A; 5/3 — перевёрнутое отношение.

items.stem: In a right triangle, the side opposite acute angle θ has length 7 and the side adjacent to θ has length 24. What is tan θ?
items.explanation: tan = противолежащий / прилежащий = 7/24 (A). 7/25 — sin; 24/25 — cos; 24/7 — перевёрнутый tan.

items.stem: A 45°-45°-90° triangle has legs of length 5. What is the length of the hypotenuse, rounded to the nearest tenth?
items.explanation: Гипотенуза = катет · √2 = 5√2 ≈ 7.07 ≈ 7.1.

items.stem: In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the shortest side has length 4. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
items.explanation: Гипотенуза вдвое длиннее катета против 30°: 8 (C). 4√3 — длинный катет; 8√3 — умножили лишний раз на √3.

items.stem: For an acute angle θ, cos θ = 0.6. What is sin θ?
items.explanation: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1: sin θ = √(1 − 0.36) = 0.8 (C) — это треугольник 3-4-5. 0.4 — вычли 0.6 из 1 без квадратов; 1.6 — сложили.

items.stem: A 10-foot ladder leans against a vertical wall. The base of the ladder is 6 feet from the wall. How many feet up the wall does the top of the ladder reach?
items.explanation: Лестница — гипотенуза: √(100 − 36) = 8 футов.

items.stem: Which of the following sets of side lengths forms a right triangle?
A right triangle has an acute angle of 30° and a hypotenuse of length 12. What is the length of the side opposite the 30° angle?
items.explanation: sin 30° = 1/2, противолежащий катет 6 (A). 6√3 — катет против 60°; 24 — удвоили вместо деления.

items.stem: A straight support cable runs from the top of a vertical 15-meter pole to a point on level ground 8 meters from the base of the pole. How long is the cable, in meters?
items.explanation: Столб и земля — катеты, трос — гипотенуза: √(225 + 64) = √289 = 17 м.

items.stem: What is the value of sin 30°?
items.explanation: В треугольнике 30-60-90 катет против 30° вдвое меньше гипотенузы: sin 30° = 1/2 (A). √3/2 — sin 60°; √2/2 — sin 45°; 1 — sin 90°.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 8, and BC = 6. What is cos A?
items.explanation: Гипотенуза AB = 10. Для угла A прилежащий катет AC = 8: cos A = 8/10 = 4/5 (B). 3/5 — sin A; 3/4 — tan A; 4/3 — tan B.

items.stem: A rectangle has a length of 21 and a width of 20. What is the length of a diagonal of the rectangle?
items.explanation: Диагональ — гипотенуза: √(400 + 441) = √841 = 29.

items.stem: For an acute angle x°, sin x° = 0.4. What is the value of cos (90 − x)°?
items.explanation: Синус угла равен косинусу дополнительного угла: cos(90 − x)° = sin x° = 0.4 (A). 0.6 — вычли из 1; 0.92 — посчитали cos x°.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AB = 17, and BC = 8. What is tan A?
items.explanation: AC = √(289 − 64) = 15. tan A = противолежащий BC / прилежащий AC = 8/15 (A). 8/17 — sin A; 15/17 — cos A; 15/8 — tan B.

items.stem: From a point on level ground 40 meters from the base of a building, the angle of elevation to the top of the building is 35°. To the nearest meter, what is the height of the building?
In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the longer leg has length 6√3. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
items.explanation: Длинный катет = короткий · √3, значит короткий 6, гипотенуза 12 (B). 6 — короткий катет; 12√3 — удвоили длинный катет.

items.stem: In right triangle PQR, angle Q is the right angle and sin P = 5/13. What is cos R?
items.explanation: P и R дополняют друг друга до 90°, поэтому cos R = sin P = 5/13 (A). 12/13 — cos P; 5/12 — tan P.

items.stem: The diagonal of a square has a length of 10. What is the area of the square?
items.explanation: s√2 = 10, s² = 100/2 = 50. Площадь квадрата — половина квадрата диагонали.

items.stem: A straight kite string is 50 meters long and makes an angle of 60° with the level ground. To the nearest tenth of a meter, how high above the ground is the kite?
items.explanation: Высота — катет против 60°: 50 · sin 60° ≈ 43.3 м (C). 25 — взяли cos 60°; 35.4 — sin 45°; 86.6 — умножили на √3.

items.stem: An isosceles right triangle has legs of length x and a hypotenuse of length 12. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: x√2 = 12, x = 12/√2 = 6√2 (B). 12√2 — умножили вместо деления; 6 — разделили на 2.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, cos B = 0.28, and AB = 25. What is the length of BC?
items.explanation: Для угла B прилежащий катет BC: cos B = BC/AB, BC = 0.28 · 25 = 7.

items.stem: What is the distance between the points (1, 2) and (7, 10) in the xy-plane?
items.explanation: Катеты 6 и 8: √(36 + 64) = 10 (B). 14 — сложили катеты; 100 — забыли корень; 8 — только вертикальная разность.

items.stem: For an acute angle θ, tan θ = 1. What is the measure of θ?
items.explanation: tan θ = 1, когда катеты равны — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник: 45° (B). tan 30° ≈ 0.577, tan 60° ≈ 1.732, tan 90° не определён.

items.stem: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 26 and one leg of length 10. What is the area of the triangle?
items.explanation: Второй катет √(676 − 100) = 24, площадь 10 · 24/2 = 120.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, angle A measures 60°, and AC = 5. What is the length of BC?
items.explanation: tan 60° = BC/AC, BC = 5√3 (B). 10 — гипотенуза AB; 5√3/3 — взяли tan 30°; 5√2 — треугольник 45-45-90.

items.stem: A 13-foot ladder leans against a vertical wall and reaches 12 feet up the wall. The base of the ladder is then moved 2 feet farther from the wall. How high up the wall does the ladder reach now, in feet?
items.explanation: Сначала основание в 5 футах (5-12-13), потом в 7: √(169 − 49) = √120 ≈ 10.95 (B). 10 — опустили на 2 фута вместе с основанием; √145 — сложили квадраты.

items.stem: For an acute angle θ, sin θ = 5/13. What is the value of tan θ?
items.explanation: cos θ = 12/13 (треугольник 5-12-13), tan θ = sin/cos = 5/12.

items.stem: From the top of a 30-meter-tall lighthouse, the angle of depression to a boat is 30°. How far is the boat from the base of the lighthouse, in meters?
items.explanation: Угол при лодке тоже 30° (накрест лежащие углы). tan 30° = 30/d, d = 30/tan 30° = 30√3 ≈ 52 м (B). 10√3 — умножили на tan 30°; 60 — гипотенуза; 15 — половина высоты.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and sin A = 0.6. What is tan B?
items.explanation: sin A = BC/AB = 3/5, значит AC = 4. tan B = противолежащий AC / прилежащий BC = 4/3 (B). 3/4 — tan A; 3/5 и 4/5 — синус и косинус.

items.stem: A rectangular box measures 3 inches by 4 inches by 12 inches. What is the length, in inches, of a diagonal that runs from one corner of the box through its interior to the opposite corner?
items.explanation: Диагональ основания √(9 + 16) = 5, затем √(5² + 12²) = 13.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AB = 2√5, and BC = 2. What is sin B?
An equilateral triangle has sides of length 10. What is the area of the triangle?
items.explanation: Высота делит его на два треугольника 30-60-90: h = 5√3, площадь 10 · 5√3/2 = 25√3 (A). 50 — взяли высоту 10; 50√3 — забыли разделить на 2.

items.stem: For a value of x with 15 < x < 60, cos(x°) = sin((2x − 30)°). What is the value of x?
items.explanation: cos x° = sin(90 − x)°, значит 90 − x = 2x − 30 и 3x = 120, x = 40 (оба угла острые).

items.stem: An airplane climbs at a constant angle of 15° with the ground and travels 2,000 meters along its straight path. To the nearest meter, how high above the ground is the airplane?
items.explanation: Путь — гипотенуза, высота — противолежащий катет: 2000 · sin 15° ≈ 518 м (A). 536 — tan 15°; 1932 — cos 15° (горизонтальное смещение); 7464 — разделили на tan.

items.stem: In right triangle XYZ, the right angle is at Y and tan X = 2.4. If XY = 5, what is the length of XZ?
items.explanation: tan X = YZ/XY, YZ = 2.4 · 5 = 12. Гипотенуза XZ = √(25 + 144) = 13 (C). 12 — катет YZ; 17 — сумма катетов.

items.stem: An isosceles triangle has two sides of length 13 and a base of length 10. What is the area of the triangle?
items.explanation: Высота к основанию делит его пополам: √(169 − 25) = 12. Площадь 10 · 12/2 = 60.

items.stem: Which of the following is equal to cos 40°?
items.explanation: cos x° = sin(90 − x)°: cos 40° = sin 50° (A). sin 40° = cos 50° — это другое число; −cos 40° отрицательно.

items.stem: A triangle has side lengths 7, 24, and 25. What is the cosine of the smallest angle of the triangle?
items.explanation: 7² + 24² = 625 = 25², треугольник прямоугольный. Наименьший угол — против стороны 7; прилежащий катет 24: cos = 24/25 (B). 7/25 — его синус; 7/24 — тангенс.

items.stem: Two hikers start at the same point. One walks 5 kilometers due north, and the other walks 12 kilometers due east. How far apart, in kilometers, are the hikers?
items.explanation: Направления перпендикулярны: √(25 + 144) = 13 км.

items.stem: In a right triangle, the altitude drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse divides the hypotenuse into segments of lengths 4 and 9. What is the length of the altitude?
items.explanation: Высота к гипотенузе — среднее геометрическое отрезков: √(4 · 9) = 6 (B). 6.5 — среднее арифметическое; 13 — гипотенуза; 5 — разность.

items.stem: From point A on level ground, the angle of elevation to the top of a tower is 45°. From point B, which is 20 meters closer to the tower along a straight line, the angle of elevation is 60°. To the nearest meter, what is the height of the tower?
In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and sin A = cos A. If AB = 8√2, what is the length of AC?
items.explanation: sin A = cos A только при 45°: треугольник равнобедренный, катет = гипотенуза/√2 = 8.

items.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths a and b and a hypotenuse of length 10. If a = 2b, what is the value of b?
items.explanation: (2b)² + b² = 100, 5b² = 100, b = √20 = 2√5 (A). 4√5 — это a; 10/3 — разделили 10 на 3, как будто a + b = 10; 5 — половина гипотенузы.
